communes: Oeiras E S.Julião Da Barra, Paço De Arcos E Caxias

blurb.text: A coastal area between Lisbon and Estoril known for fortified wine, white or red, aged at least two years in wood and marked by an almond note. It was once sought after, but suburban building has since cut it back sharply.
